title: Huawei Opensources 505 Billion-Parameter openPangu-2.0-Pro Model, Weights and Inference Code Are Released Simultaneously

content_html:
On July 31, Huawei officially open-sourced the large model openPangu-2.0-Pro under the openPangu AI model brand openPangu, along with model weights, basic inference code, and technical reports, further promoting the construction of the Ascend AI ecosystem and providing best practices for developers and enterprises based on native Ascend training and inference technologies.

According to the information, openPangu-2.0-Pro is a large-scale Mixture of Experts (MoE) language model trained on Ascend NPU, with a total parameter scale of approximately 505B (505 billion), about 18B parameters activated per token, supporting a context length of 512K, and a training data size of about 34T Tokens. In the post-training phase, the model completed supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with fast and slow integration, multiple specialized reinforcement learning (RL), and achieved capability fusion through online distillation (OPD), further enhancing its overall performance.

This open-source release is an important part of Huawei's openPangu 2.0 open-source plan. At the HDC 2026 Developer Conference held in June, Huawei Executive Director, Chairman of the Product Investment Review Committee, and President of the Terminal BG, Yu Chengdong, announced that openPangu 2.0 would gradually open-source seven key components starting from June 30, including pre-training code, post-training code, and training operators. Previously, the 92B-parameter openPangu-2.0-Flash model was released first on June 30.

Regarding the total parameter scale of openPangu-2.0-Pro being 505B, Yu Chengdong stated that Huawei will allocate a large amount of AI computing resources to support the domestic industry ecosystem. However, Huawei's available computing power is relatively limited, and AI training costs continue to be high. Therefore, Huawei pays more attention to optimizing the model's efficiency in terms of latency and throughput. As openPangu 2.0 continues to open up core models and training capabilities, the Ascend-native AI development ecosystem is expected to be further improved and provide more open-source references for the development of domestic large models.

content_html_zh:
7月31日，华为正式开源openPangu人工智能模型品牌openPangu下的大模型openPangu-2.0-Pro，以及模型权重、基础推理代码和技术报告，进一步推动Ascend AI生态建设，为开发者和企业提供基于Ascend原生训练和推理技术的最佳实践。

资料显示，openPangu-2.0-Pro是在Ascend NPU上训练的大规模专家混合（MoE）语言模型，总参数规模约为505B（5050亿），每个token激活约18B个参数，支持上下文长度为512K，训练数据大小约为34T Token。 在训练后阶段，模型完成了快慢融合的监督微调（SFT）、多种专业强化学习（RL），并通过在线蒸馏（OPD）实现了能力融合，进一步提升了整体性能。

本次开源发布是华为openPangu 2.0开源计划的重要组成部分。 在6月举行的HDC 2026开发者大会上，华为常务董事、产品投审委员会主席、终端BG总裁余承东宣布，openPangu 2.0将从6月30日起逐步开源包括预训练代码、后训练代码、训练算子在内的7个关键组件。 此前，92B参数的openPangu-2.0-Flash模型已于6月30日首发。

对于openPangu-2.0-Pro的总参数规模为505B，余承东表示，华为将配置大量的AI计算资源来支持国内的产业生态。 然而，华为可用的算力相对有限，AI训练成本持续居高不下。 因此，华为更加注重在延迟和吞吐量方面优化模型的效率。 随着openPangu 2.0不断开放核心模型和训练能力，Ascend-native AI开发生态有望进一步完善，为国内大型模型的开发提供更多开源参考。
